summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Attendance app. 39/39 backend pytest cases passed covering auth (login admin/member, /me, 401), office config (get/put/regenerate-qr with role enforcement), members CRUD with admin-only enforcement, attendance check-in (invalid QR -> 400, far GPS -> 400, success, duplicate -> 400) and checkout (computes hours), presence board statuses, leaves create/list/decide with member-vs-admin role checks, /me/stats, /admin/summary, /reports/hours + /reports/daily, and CSV/PDF exports with correct content-type (PDF begins with %PDF). Frontend Expo web preview loads cleanly on 390x844; login screen, presence board (with filter chips + status badges), check-in screen (with 'Simulate at office' switch ON by default), member profile (stats + apply leave + my leaves), admin dashboard (4 summary cards + 4 quick actions), manage members list, leave approvals (Pending/Approved/Rejected tabs + Approve/Reject buttons), reports screen (Hours/Daily toggle + This Week/Month + Export CSV/PDF), and Office QR (renders a real QR SVG with token + regenerate button) all render correctly with proper testIDs. No deprecated Expo packages found (uses expo-camera, expo-location). No React Native red screens. Only console warning observed: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from third-party lib, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' observed on every screen load. Likely originates from a third-party RN library; safe to ignore but could be tracked. Reference: browser console on https://attendance-app-220.preview.emergentagent.com/

action_items: Note: Camera-based QR scan + photo capture cannot be exercised in web preview (no camera). Native build needed for full e2e of the scan+photo flow. Backend check-in/out API is fully verified.
Optional: investigate source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (likely from react-native-web or a UI lib) and silence if possible.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~684 lines — manageable but approaching the 700-line guideline; could be split into routers (auth/office/members/attendance/leaves/reports) as it grows.

GET /api/members is accessible to any authenticated user (intentional for presence/avatars), but exposes emails of all members to every signed-in user. Confirm this is acceptable; otherwise restrict admin-only or return a slimmer schema for members.
DELETE /api/members/{id} returns 200 even when the id does not exist (delete_one is idempotent). Consider 404 if not matched, for client correctness.
PATCH /api/leaves/{id} does not validate that the leave is currently 'pending' before deciding — admins can re-decide an already approved/rejected leave. Acceptable but worth confirming.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all screens render, all critical testIDs present)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed members on the fly and clean them up via fixtures (delete_member endpoint). One temporary tour leave is created and approved for the Arjun-like fresh member during the leave class run, then the member (and their leaves) are deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py (pytest). Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_api.py -v. Frontend: web preview cannot exercise camera QR scan or real GPS — use the 'Simulate at office' switch (default ON) on /checkin and the backend tests for check-in/out logic. Office geofence center: lat 19.0760, lng 72.8777, radius 100m. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All review-request items pass.
